title: Beiersdorf CFO on the Middle East conflict, US tariffs and its Russia presence
summary: Beiersdorf Group CFO Astrid Hermann claimed that a continued oil price above US$100, the result of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, could cause significant upward pressure on costs, and talked about the company’s ongoing presence in Russia

extraction.key_fact: 바이어스도르프 CFO는 중동 분쟁에 따른 유가 상승이 비용 부담을 키울 수 있다고 말했다.
